title: Design: Delete Credit Term confirmation looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 9 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-12 Nine.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-11-delete-credit-term-confirmation.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window opens over the dimmed page (as in ct-p1-11-delete-credit-term-confirmation.png): the bold title "Confirmation" with a close × at the right, the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?", and at the bottom right "Cancel" then a red "Delete Credit Term". The Cancel style (grey filled in this build picture) and the blue ×: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R9: “"Delete Credit Term" opens a confirmation titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Delete Credit Term". On confirm the term is removed from the page and a success toast shows "{name} deleted".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Delete Credit Term chosen | "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" | Confirmation titled "Confirmation", buttons "Cancel" and red "Delete Credit Term"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
